# Gerardo Pressure Washing — Print-Ready Business Card

Single print-ready PDF for the Gerardo Pressure Washing business card.

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `gerardo-card.pdf` | Navy front (white "Gerardo [Last]", spray-nozzle wordmark, "Call Gerardo" QR) + cream back (website QR, services, contact info, "Crystal clear." tagline). 2 pages: page 1 = front, page 2 = back. |

## ⚠ Placeholder values — replace before printing

The current PDF was built with placeholder data:

| Placeholder | Replace with |
|---|---|
| `Gerardo [Last]` | actual last name |
| `(904) 555-0100` | actual phone number |
| `gerardo@gerardopressurewash.com` | actual email |
| `gerardopressurewash.com` | actual website (or remove the line if no site yet) |

To update:
1. Edit `card/print.html` and `card/web.html` (and `index.html` for the preview).
2. Edit `scripts/build-qr.sh` — change `PHONE=` and `WEB=` at the top.
3. Run `./scripts/build-qr.sh` to regenerate the QR codes with the real values.
4. Run `./scripts/build-print.sh` to rebuild this PDF.

## Specs

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Trim size | **3.5 in × 2 in** (US standard, 89 × 51 mm) |
| Bleed | 0.125 in (3.175 mm) all sides — background extends to bleed edge |
| Page size | **3.75 in × 2.25 in** (270 × 162 pt) |
| Safe zone | 0.125 in inside trim |
| Color space | sRGB (printer converts to CMYK during proofing) |
| Resolution | Vector (logo SVG, QR codes are SVG) |
| Fonts | Outfit + Inter, embedded as vector paths |
| Pages | 2 (front, back) — most printers want this for duplex |
| Accent color | `#0EA5E9` (sky-500, water-themed) |

## Uploading to common print services

### Vistaprint (vistaprint.com) — Recommended
1. Choose **Standard Business Cards** → 3.5 × 2 in.
2. When asked "How would you like to design?", choose **Upload a complete design**.
3. Upload `gerardo-card.pdf`. Vistaprint detects the 2 pages and asks which is front and which is back — page 1 is front, page 2 is back.
4. They'll show a proof; confirm the bleed area looks right and place the order.
5. Recommended paper: **Premium** or **Premium Plus**, **Matte** finish.

### Moo (moo.com)
1. Choose **Business Cards** → **Standard** size.
2. Upload **two separate files** — Moo wants front and back separately.
3. Split the PDF (Preview.app: open PDF, drag each page out of sidebar to make two new files).
4. Upload page 1 to "front" slot, page 2 to "back".

### GotPrint (gotprint.com)
1. **Business Cards** → 3.5 × 2 in, choose **Standard** or **Premium**.
2. Upload PDF — bleed at 0.125 in matches their template.

### Local print shop
- **Trim**: 3.5 × 2 in
- **Bleed**: 0.125 in (page is 3.75 × 2.25)
- **Two-sided** (page 1 front, page 2 back)
- **Color**: sRGB → convert to your house CMYK profile
- **Stock**: 14–16 pt cover stock, matte finish

## Project structure

```
gerardo/
├── index.html              ← landing page (preview the card)
├── card/
│   ├── card.css            ← Gerardo-specific styles (.g-front, .g-back)
│   ├── print.html          ← 2-page print sheet for PDF generation
│   └── web.html            ← interactive flip card for sharing/email signature
├── shared/
│   ├── fonts.css           ← Google Fonts CSS (Outfit + Inter)
│   ├── tokens.css          ← color + typography tokens (water-blue accent)
│   ├── print.css           ← 3.5x2" trim + 0.125" bleed page setup
│   ├── flip.css            ← flip animation for web.html
│   ├── img/
│   │   ├── logo-white.svg  ← wordmark on dark backgrounds (front)
│   │   └── logo-navy.svg   ← wordmark on light backgrounds (back/marketing)
│   └── qr/                 ← generated by build-qr.sh
├── scripts/
│   ├── build-qr.sh         ← regenerate QR codes (run when phone/url changes)
│   └── build-print.sh      ← regenerate the PDF (run after any edit)
└── dist/
    ├── gerardo-card.pdf    ← upload this to your printer
    └── README.md           ← this file
```

## Independence from SDC website

This entire `gerardo/` folder lives outside `JoseFinal/production/` and shares no assets, scripts, or styles with the SDC Solutions website. It can be deleted, moved, or hosted independently without affecting the SDC site.
